final: WITH frequency_stats AS (SELECT a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 0 - t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.frequency), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS threshold FROM frequency_stats) SELECT AVG(f.avg_signed_amount), AVG(f.avg_balance), AVG(f.avg_signed_amount - o.threshold) FROM frequency_stats AS f CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.threshold IS NOT NULL AND f.avg_signed_amount > o.threshold
